source.title: Eversong Diamond quality rank 2 of 2 — GoldCap item identity

notes: Rank-2 item 242712 explicitly says it is acquired by prospecting Midnight ore. Ore-specific one-point specialization unlock is from https://www.wow-professions.com/midnight/jewelcrafting-guide; preexisting v3 condition rows cover rank-1 item 242608 only. This is an identity/unlock mapping, NOT a new observed diamond drop, rate or rank-specific cohort. No skill threshold or P(hit) measured.
requires: Proficient Processor > Prospecting Pro > Copper Consumer: at least 1 Knowledge Point in this ore's node (same ore-gate as rank-1 diamond 242608)
